text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What was that just now?! A flash of 
light just went whooooosh all over...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
M-My body is burning up...! Power is 
surging from deep within!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...Great Goddesses, I understand now! 
You're telling me to protect the peace 
with this power, right!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
With this inner flame, I'll light up 
everyone's hearts! Behold the birth of the 
new Justice Biko!!
